title: Doesn’t work as before
body: I’ve been using this app for years now and recently it just became too bugged. During one session I only can check one habit, to add another day for track I need to reopen the app over and over for each habit and each day I’ve forgotten to check in. I’ve tried to reload the app today and in the settings it says that I have an old premium version but it should be working just fine, however when I try to restore my data nothing happens, the app is empty. I’ve even tried to create new habits just to see if it’s gonna work and I succeed only on the third try. My tracking story of several years is now lost and I am very disappointed, will be looking for a new app now.
author: maria_globa

title: Please releases next update
body: do not kill this app, it has great prospects!  Please make a small upgrade in UI / UX, it will be enough.
author: Qumir

title: It’s good mostly
body:
I appreciate for efforts to make really attractive app for habits tracking. 

Anyway, I would improve it.
Seem, that’s too much to have a habit for all screen, it does take too much time. That’s the main thing I don’t like. 

As a user I want to set marks for each with one tap and forget so that I could be able to see full list and mark each item quicker. 

Consider please to set
- list as a default view
- tap on an item will add a point (or on a number at least)
- a habit image as a part of a row

Thanks for any feedback.
author: FriendKirby

title: Privacy problem
body: First of all, I love this app and use it for many years. Still, there is one major privacy problem. What is the point of protecting your goals with password / touchid / faceid if 3D Touch widget reveals all my habits even if I force-close the app?

title: Thank you for a good app, fix bugs plz!
body: Thank you for a good application! It works fine on my iPhone but it badly works on my watch series 3. Time from time I don’t receive a notification (on watch) and some days I have not full list of habits on my watch (on iPhone list looks Ok but on watch I see only half of it)
author: Ivanov Anton

title: Not impressed
body: Downloaded it after it was featured in the App Store and had to purchase paid version because wanted to track more than 3 habits. Experience was not so great: lots of glitches, performance issues, painfully generic ‘inspirational’ default pictures(and yes, I know about possibility to add custom themes, but app doesn’t help at all), cards that are unusable in 95% cases, glitchy inconvenient widget and overall so-so experience. It’s not broken but not good either. Maybe it’s better for tracking 2-3 daily habits, but not many, it gets messy and unclear. Switched to an alternative app

title: Awesome app, that crashes time to time
body:
App is really cool, and smartly customizable (is flexible to create personal settings, but doesn’t take too much time to do so).
Though, it crashes in different places all the time. For example - I need to open it twice, before it actually launches (in 50% times). Another crash happens when I want to view/edit data in chart widget within the habit.
